pages.text:
Smelts steel and the tier alloys, with slag as a by-product.
It has three inputs: the metal (iron for steel), an additive for the alloys (leave it empty for steel), and coal coke. Coal coke is both its fuel and its reagent: burning it heats the furnace toward 1,600°C, and it keeps back what each smelt uses. Coal coke blocks work as nine coal coke.
Each recipe needs the furnace hot enough: steel from 1,200°C, the alloys from 1,200 to 1,500°C.
Open it from the port.
